From: | k.m.rao @tirupati.edu.in |
To: | a.bhagwati@kmail.com |
Date: [3 April |
Subject: | Online classes |
Dear Ms. Bhagwati:
Thank you for your interest in teaching in our online business program. After reviewing
your application materials, we would like to offer you an instructor’s position for the
upcoming semester. Your educational qualifications, teaching history, and many years of
professional experience as a bookkeeper at a local business make you an ideal candidate
for our program.
Our coordinator of online instruction, Kamal Pawar, has experience with teaching our
online classes. He will be contacting you shortly with details about the class materials.
Please note that these will need to be submitted by the first week in May so that they
can be finalized by the end of June in time for the beginning of classes.
K. M. Rao, Director of Human Resources
____))
< http://www. tirupati.edu.in/business/onlineclasses
TIRUPATI UNIVERSITY
Tirupati University’s online business classes are developed and taught by highly qualified
instructors. All video and audio lectures, support materials, and quizzes are reviewed and vetted
by Tirupati University faculty before their use to ensure they meet the university’s rigorous
standards.
July-December Class Offerings
Applied Accounting
Learn the basic accounting principles used in financial statements and financial records (balance
sheets, accounts payable and receivable, payroll, etc.) of small to midsize businesses.
Global Finance
This class covers investments and financial decisions in a global setting. Learn concepts and
tools to allow you to bring basic principles of finance to bear to make practical decisions about
resources.
Advanced Management
Master techniques for overseeing and organizing a workforce in any context, whether corporate
or small business, non-profit or public service.
The Science of Decision Making
Learn how our cultural and psychological-emotional background shapes our choices. Through
case studies on persuasion and incentives, you will learn to make more creative yet responsible
decisions.
106
TU Offers Online Classes
12 August—Last month, Tirupati University
became the latest institution in the region to
offer online business classes. Students can
choose from a range of full-credit classes
provided entirely over the Internet.
Vice Chancellor Dr. R. D. Mehta noted,
““We’re excited about this new direction and so
are our students. They like the convenience
and flexibility.” Like Tirupati’s traditional
courses, all online classes are taught by highly
qualified instructors, who are required to have
an MBA or an advanced degree in a related
field. According to Dr. Mehta, the university
plans to expand its online class offerings in the
spring.

Hf *电子邮件* a=
发件人: | k.m.rao @tirupati.edu.in |
收件人: | a.bhagwati@kmail.com |
日期: [4月3日 |
主题: | 在线课程 |
尊敬的 Bhagwati 女士：
感谢您对在我们在线商业项目中任教的兴趣。在审阅了您的申请材料后，我们希望为您即将到来的学期提供一名讲师职位。您的教育资历、教学经验以及您在当地企业担任簿记员多年的专业经验使您成为我们项目理想的人选。
我们的在线教学协调员 Kamal Pawar 具有教授我们在线课程的经验。他将很快与您联系，告知您有关课程材料的详细信息。
请注意，这些材料需要在五月第一周前提交，以便能在六月底前定稿，赶上开课时间。
K. M. Rao，人力资源总监
____))
< http://www.tirupati.edu.in/business/onlineclasses
TIRUPATI UNIVERSITY
Tirupati 大学在线商业课程由高素质的讲师开发和授课。所有视频和音频讲座、支持材料和测验在使用前都经过 Tirupati 大学教职员工的审核和审查，以确保它们符合大学严格的标准。
七月-十二月课程设置
应用会计学
学习用于小型到中型企业财务报表和财务记录（资产负债表、应付账款和应收账款、工资单等）的基本会计原则。
全球金融
本课程涵盖全球环境下的投资和财务决策。学习概念和工具，使您能够运用基本的金融原理来就资源做出实际决策。
高级管理学
掌握在任何背景下（无论是企业、小型企业、非营利组织还是公共服务）监督和组织员工队伍的技术。
决策科学
了解我们的文化和心理情感背景如何塑造我们的选择。通过关于说服力和激励的案例研究，您将学会做出更具创造性但又负责任的决定。
106
TU 提供在线课程
8月12日——上个月，Tirupati 大学成为该地区提供在线商业课程的最新机构。学生可以从完全通过互联网提供的各种学分课程中选择。
副校长 Dr. R. D. Mehta 指出：
“我们对这个新方向感到兴奋，我们的学生也是如此。他们喜欢便利性和灵活性。”与 Tirupati 的传统课程一样，所有在线课程都是由高素质的讲师教授的，这些讲师需要拥有 MBA 或相关领域的高级学位。据 Dr. Mehta 介绍，大学计划在春季扩大其在线课程的范围。
